dedupe_keys.name: higgs inventory of the european gas transmission grid for hydrogen blending

description: This workbook assesses the quantitative structure of the existing European gas transmission grid, focusing on the asset types that are sensitive to hydrogen admixture and that would bring significant cost if modified or renewed. It was published on Zenodo in March 2023 by Michael Walter, Armin Bollien, Javier Sánchez-Láinez, Hiltrud Schülken, Alberto Cerezo Alarcón, Vanesa Gil and María Dolores Storch de Gracia Calvo as a work package 2 output of the HIGGS project on hydrogen in gas grids. The inventory counts and characterises asset elements of the transmission system to support estimates of what hydrogen blending would require. Coverage is the European gas transmission network. The data are one small Excel workbook, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the abstract is brief, and the file is dated January 2023. Simulation uses are screening hydrogen readiness and retrofit cost of gas transmission networks. Related records: model-lanl-phydras-hydrogen-blending-pipelines models blending in pipelines, and data-gamamod-german-gas-transmission-grid covers the German grid in detail.
